verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of markdown skills that plugs into coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Devin CLI and Gemini CLI. It has no UI of its own and no API surface, so asking for API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it shipping either a UI or an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
